highlights: Ask Questions now pauses and resumes a run through any embedded provider, not only native Codex, with each question bound to the exact user, session, run, and tool call.
Files an Agent links to open where they live: Portal uploads in Files, workspace files in a private, bounded Remote Desktop handoff that fails closed on unsafe paths.
The workspace refresh screen is now a branded Portal curtain using your uploaded logo, a restrained dot matrix, and glass status, opaque from the first frame.
Agent Chat recovers dropped provider streams, restores the correct provider and agent sessions, and reassembles a final reply split across frames.
OpenClaw backups omit volatile Codex runtime data, capture committed SQLite WAL state via the online backup API, and strip stale outbound deliveries so a restore cannot replay them.
